name: Foundry: Meltdown
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: MELTDOWN — the THE FOUNDRY circuit's COLLAPSING-ARENA FINALE (tier 3; v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md §2.8 headline archetype + §3.1 row 3). A second LAST-ONE-FLYING stage that plays the OPPOSITE cascade to meltdown_box for variety: here the molten core melts the floor from the CENTER OUT — the middle drops FIRST and the erosion front races toward the edges — so players are shoved OUTWARD off the collapsing core, then the edges go too and everyone is airborne over the void. Last one still flying wins. Fair NOT because it is recoverable but because EVERYONE'S floor erodes on the SAME schedule, SYMMETRICALLY (§2.8's key point) — no player keeps ground another loses. The void beneath is the shared killer; flight is the shared escape.

FANTASY (owner headline, §2.8): 'the floor is disappearing under everyone — stay in the air and be the last one flying.' The molten foundry floor gives way beneath you; the level itself removes the ground and dares you to fly (Pillars 2 no-standing + 4 death-is-cheap-and-funny, at the limit).

HOW IT'S BUILT (composed from Batch-1 destructible_block only — no new mechanic): the floor is 8 destructible_block segments (x0..2400 @ top1080, w300 h140, trampoline tier so bouncing to gain height is the skill), each break_on 'timed', erosion CENTER-OUT in symmetric pairs on the same schedule: center pair (x900,x1200) at t3.0s, then (x600,x1500) t4.5s, (x300,x1800) t6.0s, edge pair (x0,x2100) t7.5s — so the safe footing splits and shrinks toward the two edges and is GONE by ~7.5s (climax around the ~10s stage TTL). Two trampoline WALL columns (x-180 and x2400, h680) contain the early bounce-fight and erode LAST (t8.5s), completing the 'box fully dissolved' read. Every block telegraphs its break with growing CRACKS + a SHUDDER + a hazard-red flash for telegraph_s=1.0s BEFORE it vanishes (fairness §2.0#2 — you SEE where the floor goes next and flee to an intact edge). All arm off EventBus.combat_started, so the countdown/intro never erodes the box early.

FAIRNESS (§2.8): everyone's floor erodes on the SAME symmetric schedule; spawns are symmetric on the intact floor; a healthy fuelled player boosts to stay aloft as the floor goes (~700px of recovery sky under the floor: floor bottom y1220 -> bottom blast line y1920). The center-out order means the DANGER STARTS UNDER MID-MAP spawns and the safe refuge is the outer edges (until they too go) — the mirror of meltdown_box's flee-inward, so a player who has learned one does not auto-win the other.

KILL IDENTITY (§2.0#4, credit unchanged): falls into the exposed void = off-screen ring-out kills via PartyMatch's bounds check -> kill(&ring_out). A rival who SMASHED you off just before your block broke is credited within the 6.0s window; a pure 'ran out of floor' fall is an UNCREDITED self-fall (killer=-1). QA NOTE (relaxed K1' per §2.8): expect a HIGH uncredited-self-fall share on this archetype BY DESIGN — judge it against this note, NOT the standard >=88% void_is_floor target. Kills still happen via smash-offs during the early bounce-fight + the void as the core collapses.

BACKDROP: open_sky, clouds off, MOLTEN palette (near-black char roof over a deep smelt-orange glow, horizon glow on) — reads as a foundry going critical, not a meadow. The void render (dark bottomless gradient + receding canyon walls + under-lip AO + matte hazard-red rim/chevrons + falling motes) marks the whole bottom unmistakably lethal.
